artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the square-perimeter normal form and fixed-prime-support constructions, with asymptotic spot checks.
Deterministic verification output: 1,266,847 primitive Euclidean pairs checked, 150 square-perimeter cases, zero mismatches, and zero construction failures.

limitations: The asymptotic counts primitive triangles up to interchange of the legs, not distinct perimeter values. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; an equivalent refinement could exist in older recreational or problem literature under different terminology.
record_title: Fixed prime support in square-perimeter primitive Pythagorean triangles
scientific_context: Primitive Pythagorean triangles with square perimeter admit a complete classification at every prescribed finite odd-prime support via a signed logarithmic fractional-part condition, together with an explicit support-wise counting asymptotic.
